meaningMnemonic: A person (人) who has grown one (一) extra line right across their outstretched arms. Nobody gets bigger than that.
readingMnemonic: Something that big makes you throw your arms open and go 'ta-DAH' — dà, falling hard in fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: One thin rod (丨) with eight (八) split off either side — shavings, and nothing is smaller than a shaving.
readingMnemonic: Small things only get a whispered 'shyow' (xiǎo), third tone dipping down to nothing.

meaningMnemonic: A rod (丨) skewered straight through a mouth (口), dead centre. It also names the Middle Kingdom.
readingMnemonic: The rod goes 'JONG' (zhōng) as it hits the middle of the target, flat first tone.

meaningMnemonic: A rod (丨) standing on the line (一) with a mark growing above it. Everything about this character points up.
readingMnemonic: Look up too fast and you 'shong' (shàng) your head on the shelf.

meaningMnemonic: Everything hangs below the line (一): the rod (丨) drops and a dot (丶) falls off the end of it.
readingMnemonic: Down the slide you go with a 'shyah!' (xià).

meaningMnemonic: A line (一) with a slash, a rod and a dot scribbled underneath: the sky with the answer crossed out.
readingMnemonic: 'Boo!' (bù) is what the crowd shouts when the answer is no. Before a fourth tone it lifts to bú.

meaningMnemonic: A woman (女) with her child (子) beside her. In this writing system that picture simply means good.
readingMnemonic: You look at them and ask 'how good is that?' — hǎo, third tone.

meaningMnemonic: The sun (日) and the moon (月) in the sky at once. Twice the light: bright, and by extension clear.
readingMnemonic: A Ming (míng) vase is glazed so well it shines in both lights.

meaningMnemonic: The sun (日) already ten (十) fingers above the horizon, and you are up to see it. Early.
readingMnemonic: You greet the sunrise with a sleepy 'zow' (zǎo).

meaningMnemonic: One slash (丿) of light coming off the sun (日) — the colour it bleaches everything into.
readingMnemonic: Wave 'bye' (bái): you have gone white as a sheet.

meaningMnemonic: One (一) line drawn above even the biggest (大) person there is. Whatever is up there is the sky, and one turn of it is a day.
readingMnemonic: The 'tea-ANN' (tiān) party is held up in the clouds, flat first tone.

meaningMnemonic: Big (大) with one extra drop (丶) spilled on it. Big plus a bit more is too much.
readingMnemonic: Your 'tie' (tài) is knotted too tight to breathe.

meaningMnemonic: A person (亻) wearing a ribbon (尔) with their name on it: the one I am pointing at.
readingMnemonic: I point at the ribbon and tap your 'knee' (nǐ).

meaningMnemonic: A person (亻), and also (也) a person — just not the one in front of you. He, over there.
readingMnemonic: He is so far off you only manage a flat 'tah' (tā).

meaningMnemonic: A woman (女), and also (也) not the one you are speaking to. She.
readingMnemonic: Exactly the same 'tah' (tā) as 他. Spoken Mandarin cannot tell them apart; only the page can.

meaningMnemonic: A crowd of people (亻) pouring through one door (门). Add it to a person word and you get more of them.
readingMnemonic: A doorway full of 'men' (men) — unstressed, no tone at all.

meaningMnemonic: A person (亻) holding up ten (十) fingers and asking which one you meant.
readingMnemonic: 'Shen?' (shén) is the noise you make when you did not catch a word, rising in second tone.

meaningMnemonic: A slash (丿) over a cocoon (厶): a scrap of a character that only ever hangs off the end of a question word.
readingMnemonic: Barely pronounced at all: a swallowed 'muh' (me).

meaningMnemonic: A mouth (口) in the doorway (门), leaning in with a question.
readingMnemonic: 'When?' (wèn) is the first thing you ask through a door.

meaningMnemonic: Sunlight (日) coming through the crack in the door (门): the gap between two things, and the room that gap opens into.
readingMnemonic: The gap is so narrow that only a 'jyen' (jiān) of light gets through.

meaningMnemonic: The woman (女) who works like a horse (马) for you.
readingMnemonic: The horse says 'maaa' (mā) and so does the baby — flat, held first tone.

meaningMnemonic: A mouth (口) and a horse (马). Tack it onto the end of a sentence and the whole thing becomes a question.
readingMnemonic: The same horse noise as 妈, but flat and unstressed: 'ma'.

meaningMnemonic: A child (子) kept under a roof (宀) until it has learned to write. What it learns is characters.
readingMnemonic: Each one is a 'dz' (zì) of ink pressed hard onto the page, fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: One mountain (山) climbing out on top of another. To get anywhere you have to go out over both.
readingMnemonic: The train goes 'choo!' (chū) as it pulls out of the station.

meaningMnemonic: A hand (手) held flat above the eye (目), shading it so you can look into the distance.
readingMnemonic: Genghis 'Khan' (kàn) is looking out over everything he owns.

meaningMnemonic: An eye (目) up a tree (木) with a heart (心) underneath: you look at a thing, then you feel about it. That is thinking — and wanting.
readingMnemonic: Thinking hard, you draw out a 'shyang' (xiǎng), third tone dipping while you consider.

meaningMnemonic: In the evening (夕) it is too dark to see, so a mouth (口) has to say who is coming. That is what a name is for.
readingMnemonic: Same 'míng' as 明 bright: your name is the part of you that shines.

meaningMnemonic: One evening (夕) stacked on another, and another. However many you count, there are more.
readingMnemonic: How many? 'Dwor' (duō) more than you expected.

meaningMnemonic: Break out of the cocoon (厶) and set off across the earth (土). You are going.
readingMnemonic: You leave with a short dry 'chü' (qù), lips pursed for the ü.

meaningMnemonic: The sun (日) has moved one inch (寸) across the sky. That is how time used to be measured.
readingMnemonic: Time takes 'sure' (shí) long enough — second tone rising as the sun climbs.

meaningMnemonic: A hand (又) measured against the inch (寸) mark once again, and this time it lines up exactly.
readingMnemonic: 'Dway' (duì) — the answer lands like a stamp, fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: A hand (又) with a slash (丿) reaching across for another hand. A friend is the hand you take.
readingMnemonic: 'Yo!' (yǒu) is how you greet one, third tone.

meaningMnemonic: Two moons (月) side by side, out in the sky together every night. Friends.
readingMnemonic: They bump shoulders with a 'pung' (péng), rising second tone.

meaningMnemonic: A pig (豕) under the roof (宀). Once the animals are inside with you, that is a home.
readingMnemonic: 'Jya' (jiā) is the sigh you let out when you finally get there.

meaningMnemonic: A tree (木) carrying a whole field's (田) worth of produce: fruit, and the result of everything you planted.
readingMnemonic: The fruit lands with a soft 'gwor' (guǒ).

meaningMnemonic: Strokes driven into the earth (土) like a marker post: this thing is right here.
readingMnemonic: 'Dzai' (zài) — you are at the spot, fourth tone, no argument.

meaningMnemonic: Water (氵) and a hand (又): the river people. The Han were named after a river, and their writing still carries the name.
readingMnemonic: The 'Han' (hàn) dynasty, spelled very nearly the way it sounds.

meaningMnemonic: Speech (讠) plus five (五) mouths (口): once five people agree on the same sounds, you have a language.
readingMnemonic: 'Yü' (yǔ) — round your lips for the ü and dip through the third tone.

meaningMnemonic: Speech (讠) splitting (八) out of a mouth (口) on legs (儿): words that walk right out of you.
readingMnemonic: 'Shwor' (shuō) — the sound of someone talking and not stopping.

meaningMnemonic: Speech (讠) with a tongue (舌) attached: words that have actually been said out loud.
readingMnemonic: 'Hwa!' (huà) — a burst of talk, fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: Lightning hooking (乚) down into a field (田). Caught in a wire, that is electricity.
readingMnemonic: 'Dyen' (diàn) — the zap, sharp and fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: A box (囗) inside a box (口): you travel all the way round and end up back where you started.
readingMnemonic: 'Hway' (huí) — coming back the way you came, second tone rising.

meaningMnemonic: A tree (木) with a line (一) and eight (八) more branches spreading toward you as it comes.
readingMnemonic: 'Lie' (lái) — as in 'lie down, I am coming', second tone.

meaningMnemonic: An eye (目) on legs (儿): sight that walks up to a thing. To see, and so to meet.
readingMnemonic: 'Jyen' (jiàn) — the same syllable as 间, but this one lands hard in fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: A rod (丨) of a stream with eight (八) splashes and a slash breaking off it. Water in full flow.
readingMnemonic: 'Shway' (shuǐ) — water sloshing, third tone dipping down.

meaningMnemonic: Speech (讠) from the whole body (身), bowed an inch (寸). That is real thanks.
readingMnemonic: 'Shieh' (xiè) — the sound of the bow, and you say it twice.

meaningMnemonic: A mouth (口) with a slash and a hook (乚) dragging food in.
readingMnemonic: 'Chir' (chī) — flat first tone, said with your mouth full.

meaningMnemonic: Sparks of learning (八 and 丶) landing on the cover (冖) over a child (子). Whatever happens under that roof is study.
readingMnemonic: 'Shweh' (xué) — the second tone rises like a hand going up in class.

meaningMnemonic: A hand (手) holding a spear (戈). Whoever is holding the weapon gets to say 'me'.
readingMnemonic: 'Wor' (wǒ) — third tone dipping, like pointing down at your own chest.

meaningMnemonic: The sun (日) standing upright (正): the one fact nobody argues with. That is how it is.
readingMnemonic: 'Shir' (shì) — flat, final, fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: Jade (玉) locked inside four walls (囗). Treasure with a border drawn round it is a country.
readingMnemonic: 'Gwor' (guó) — second tone rising, like a flag going up the pole.

meaningMnemonic: Someone bent over the earth (土), a slash for the stooped back and a dagger (匕) for the walking stick.
readingMnemonic: 'Louw' (lǎo) — a low third-tone groan as they sit down.

meaningMnemonic: Strokes beside a cloth (巾) banner: the one who stands at the front holding the standard.
readingMnemonic: 'Shir' (shī) — flat first tone, said with respect.

meaningMnemonic: A shoot with a slash (丿) and a line (一) pushing its way up out of the earth (土): born, alive, growing.
readingMnemonic: 'Shung' (shēng) — first tone, level as a new sprout.

meaningMnemonic: A lid (亠) over crossed strokes (乂): marks made on purpose. Writing, and all the culture that comes with it.
readingMnemonic: 'When' (wén) — second tone, and almost exactly the English word.

meaningMnemonic: An axle (十) through a line (一) inside a hooked (乚) frame. Seen from above, a cart.
readingMnemonic: 'Chuh' (chē) — the chug of an engine, flat first tone.

meaningMnemonic: A person (人) with sparks (丶 and 丿) flying off both shoulders. Fire.
readingMnemonic: 'Hwor' (huǒ) — the whoosh of a flame, dipping third tone.

meaningMnemonic: Earth (土), and also (也) all the rest of it: not one mound of soil but the whole ground.
readingMnemonic: 'Dee' (dì) — fourth tone, dropping straight down to the floor.

meaningMnemonic: A hand slashing (丿) up to grab the moon (月). If you can take hold of it, you have it.
readingMnemonic: 'Yo' (yǒu) — the same sound as 友 friend, third tone.

meaningMnemonic: Two people (人) sat down on the earth (土), one either side, talking.
readingMnemonic: 'Dzwor' (zuò) — the sound of sitting down heavily, fourth tone.
